content:
# John Adams, McCullough

- p.112: Adams on independence: "I am well aware of the toil and blood and treasure...", read this aloud to Alex.
- The Adams/Jefferson friendship -> falling out -> reconciliation arc is the whole book.
- Note: Abigail kept the farm running while John was away, reminds me of Ellen holding the books while I'm at the tavern.
- TODO: find the HBO miniseries to rewatch.

# Alexander Hamilton, Chernow

- Self-made immigrant, relentless work ethic. Built the financial system from nothing.
- The duel still feels avoidable every time I read it.
- Marginalia: ambition without restraint -> ruin. Good reminder running a business.

# Grant, Personal Memoirs

- Plain, unsentimental prose. He wrote it dying of cancer to provide for his family.
- Vicksburg campaign, patience and logistics win wars, not just battles.
- Lesson for the kitchen: prep and mise en place IS the campaign.

# Civil War notes

- Antietam / Gettysburg / Vicksburg timeline still fuzzy, make a chart.
- Reading Grant alongside Shelby Foote eventually.
- Question: how did supply lines actually feed an army that size?

# Kitchen Confidential, Bourdain

- "Your body is not a temple, it's an amusement park."
- The line-cook brotherhood chapter, every word true.
- Daniel is basically the Bourdain archetype: volatile, brilliant, loyal.

# Medium Raw, Bourdain

- More reflective than Kitchen Confidential. The part about selling out vs. surviving.
- Owning a place is nothing like cooking in one. Wish someone had told me that in 2015.

# Reading list

- [ ] The Civil War: A Narrative, Shelby Foote (vol 1)
- [x] Grant, Personal Memoirs
- [ ] Truman, McCullough
- [x] Kitchen Confidential
- [ ] 1776, McCullough

# Grandmother Eleanor's Pot Roast

The original. Named the tavern signature after her. $28 on the menu, never changing.

## What I remember
- Chuck roast, seared HARD in bacon fat.
- Red wine + beef stock, bay, thyme.
- Low oven, 3+ hours. Carrots and potatoes in the last hour.

## The mystery
- There was something at the end, she'd stir something in off the heat. Mom thinks it was a spoon of cold butter + a splash of cider vinegar. Still chasing the exact taste.

# Pot roast attempts log

- Attempt 6 (3/19): added cider vinegar at the end, closest yet, but still missing the back-note.
- Attempt 5: too much wine, gravy turned sour.
- Attempt 4: butter finish helped the silkiness.
- TODO: ask Mom on Saturday FaceTime if Grandma used allspice.

# Dad's clam chowder

Christopher's version, cup $9 / bowl $13 on the menu.
- Salt pork, not bacon. Onion sweated slow.
- Bottled clam juice + the liquor from the cans.
- Finish with cream, never milk. Oyster crackers on the side.

# Apple pie, Eleanor

House Apple Pie $10.
- Mix of Granny Smith + Honeycrisp.
- Lard + butter crust. Cinnamon light, nutmeg lighter.
- Brush with egg wash, coarse sugar on top.

# Sunday gravy notes

Not on the menu, just for family Sundays.
- Long simmer, pork neck + sausage.
- Make a double batch, freeze half.

# Fall winter menu ideas

- Braised Short Rib as a fall special (~$32), costing with Frank Russo at Empire Meat.
- Lean harder on clay-pot dishes when it's cold.
- Swap seasonal cobbler to apple-cranberry.
- Keep [[Grandmother Eleanor's Pot Roast]] front and center.
- Photograph everything before the WordPress/Contentful update + Algolia reindex.

# Patio expansion thoughts

Target 2027 season. 24 -> ~36 covers.
- Need 3 contractor quotes; railing alone came back $14K.
- Budget ceiling ~$45K, don't drain the $30K emergency fund.
- DCWP sidewalk café application + updated COI.
- Heaters + string lights so we can run patio later into October.

# Wine tasting series ideas

American craft wineries, Sunday evenings, ~$85pp, 24 seats via Eventbrite.
- Themes: Finger Lakes Riesling / West Coast Pinot / Napa Cabernet flight.
- Claire Bennett (Hudson Valley Wine Imports) handles allocations.
- Daniel designs a 5-course pairing.

# Kevin Walsh fish pricing prep

Q4 renegotiation with Atlantic Seafood Supply.
- Pull 12 months of cod + salmon spend.
- He calls every Tuesday, bring numbers to that call.
- Walkaway: source backup supplier if cod jumps >10%.

# Staff notes

- Sophia (manager), rock solid, give her more of the events.
- Daniel (head chef), needs the walk-in fixed, he's right to push.
- Nina killing it behind the bar, let her own the seasonal cocktail menu.
- Holiday party 12/12 after close.

# The Eleanor cocktail tweaks

Signature bourbon cocktail, $15.
- Try a touch less sweet, cut the demerara syrup.
- Big rock, orange peel expressed.
- Nina's idea: a smoked variant for fall.

# 2026-03-21

- Busy Saturday dinner, ~150 covers.
- Walk-in still reading 41°F, calling the tech Monday. See [[Patio expansion thoughts]] later, fix the cold box first.
- Pot roast attempt this week tasted close, logged in [[Pot roast attempts log]].

# 2026-03-22

- Sunday: pickup soccer at Astoria Park, then jazz brunch service.
- FaceTime with Mom, asked about Grandma's pot roast finish.
- Read more [[Grant - Personal Memoirs]] on the East River walk after close.

- idea: smoked Eleanor cocktail for fall
- TODO: 3rd patio contractor quote
- ask Mom: allspice in the pot roast?
